# external-dns-crds

<!-- GENERATED by tooling/crdgen. Do not edit. -->

CustomResourceDefinitions for ExternalDNS (DNSEndpoint, DNSRecord).

CRDs are copied verbatim from [kubernetes-sigs/external-dns](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/external-dns)
at tag [`v0.23.0`](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/external-dns/tree/v0.23.0) (commit `a10c5665a5bc30e7163eb17e853e317964500e99`),
path(s) `config/crd/standard`, and rendered as regular Helm templates so that
`helm upgrade` updates them (Helm's own `crds/` directory never upgrades).

## Install

```sh
helm install external-dns oci://ghcr.io/spnngl/charts/external-dns-crds --version <version>
```

Chart `version` equals the upstream version it ships; `appVersion` is always the exact upstream version.
Installing requires Kubernetes >=1.16.0.

### Already have these CRDs?

If the CRDs were installed by the operator chart or `kubectl apply`, Helm refuses with
"rendered manifests contain a resource that already exists". Either let Helm adopt them:

```sh
helm install external-dns oci://ghcr.io/spnngl/charts/external-dns-crds --version <version> --take-ownership   # Helm >= 3.17
```

or, on older Helm, hand them over first (replace `<release>` and `<namespace>`):

```sh
kubectl annotate crd dnsendpoints.externaldns.k8s.io dnsrecords.externaldns.k8s.io \
  meta.helm.sh/release-name=<release> meta.helm.sh/release-namespace=<namespace> --overwrite
kubectl label crd dnsendpoints.externaldns.k8s.io dnsrecords.externaldns.k8s.io \
  app.kubernetes.io/managed-by=Helm --overwrite
```

| Key | Type | Default | Description |

| `labels` | object | `{}` | Extra labels added to every CRD. |
| `keepOnUninstall` | bool | `true` | Add `helm.sh/resource-policy: keep` so CRDs (and all their custom resources) survive `helm uninstall`. |
